verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships through its own marketplace (`/plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace`) and has a public listing on claude.com/plugins that describes its skills, so you can review what it offers before running `/plugin install`. However, the documented 'Skills-search tool for discovery' appears to be an in-plugin capability that works only after installation, not a pre-install catalog. missing for 10: evidence of a browsable or searchable pre-install skill registry or leaderboard, documentation of how to browse marketplace contents before installing, independent hands-on corroboration of the discovery flow.
